observation: Front, top and iso inspected. The broad shallow bell is centred over the stand and radial bead corona; its three colour regions meet continuously and its sixteen rim scallops are visible. All eight strands hang within the foot-height envelope, with four narrower wavy coloured strips inside them. The exposed forks, pins and root arms connect below the bell; no floating part, visible gross intersection or reversed component was found. Top occludes the internal linkage as expected; numerical interference checks remain separate. The flat crown, straight sloping skirt and substantial bead heads give a strongly mechanical appearance; independent signature review must judge the requested graceful jellyfish character.
